scenario: AITA for massaging my guy friend in front of his girlfriend? | I (32F) met my friend (30M) at work last year. We hang out a lot the three of us and I love both of them now, even if I knew him first. Today, we were hanging out at the beach for the fireworks and my guy friend was in a bad mood. I didn't realise it was an uncomfortable situation before seeing the girlfriend's face, which was a bit sceptical. I then quickly put an end to it and sat back at my place. I'm scared I made her mad, even if she was super nice to me the rest of the evening, I find myself completely stupid for not realising it would be super awkward. By the way, I'm dating someone else and I often tell them about my dates and all, so there is absolutely no ambiguity between me & him, and I always see them together, they're a package and I love it. Was I being an asshole here?
